name: Geode Predictive Input Buffer
description: Input-timing assistance for Geometry Dash. Predicts short player trajectories and buffers eligible inputs to safer physics ticks without automating gameplay.

stage.name: Prediction Stage
stage.description: Sets the maximum number of ticks an input may be delayed. Safe inputs are still passed through immediately. F6 cycles Stage 1 (2/2 ticks), Stage 2 (4/4), Stage 3 (8/8), Stage 4 (16/8), and Off. Values are All modes / Wave.

cycle-key.name: Stage Cycle Key
cycle-key.description: Cycles the active prediction stage while playing. Default: F6.

console-key.name: Console Toggle Key
console-key.description: Closes or reopens the live command-prompt console on Windows. Default: F7.

auto-scan.name: Automatic Level Scan
auto-scan.description: Starts a hidden scan after the first real physics step of a compatible attempt. It continues in small CPU slices while the level plays and never controls the real player.

route-snap.name: Use Scanned Route
route-snap.description: Optionally align an early physical input with a matching point in the scanned route. Off by default. This setting never creates inputs or controls the player, and route data can be incomplete around unsupported mechanics.
